Chapters

    Transcript

    What is Rebind?

    Rebind reads your keyboard and mouse, runs the scripts you choose, and sends input back.

    rb.on and rb.bind hear input, and rb.hid sends it.

    A script can pass a key through, swallow it, remap it, or make new input.

    Scripts you write are Luau files saved on your computer.

    Software mode needs no extra hardware. Pointer movement needs a Rebind Link, or BYOH on your own Teensy.

    Remaps, macros and Luau scripts. Free. No account for local scripts.

    What's it for?

    • remap
    • macros
    • one-handed
    • scripts
    • kill switch

    Input that fits how you move. Remaps, macros and Luau scripts. Free.

    Remap a key

    Caps Lock, now Escape.

    rb.bind.remap("CapsLock", "Escape")

    One line of Luau.

    Each rb.bind claims only its own key. The other keys reach your apps untouched.

    Remapping a side button shouldn't be a side quest.

    rb.bind.remap("Mouse4", "LCtrl+C")

    mouse 4 → ctrl + c

    Try a bind, in the browser. These demos run on this page only. They do not install Rebind and they do not change your real keyboard. The drawings are a metaphor. This page is not the Rebind app.

    Macros and text expansion

    Record a macro. Replay it with one key.

    Text expansion: type a short code, get the whole phrase.

    A script can work in just one app.

    Input that fits how you move

    Clicks, timing, and remaps shaped around your hands.

    A one-handed layer.

    Sticky modifiers, debounce and dwell-click are scripts too.

    Not a medical device.

    Kill switch

    To stop every script at once, press Left Ctrl + Left Alt + K.

    Kill switch. Stops every script and releases held input.

    macOS: Left Control + Left Option + K

    In hardware mode, press it on a keyboard you attached in Peripherals.

    Your peripherals. Your rules.

    Free to download.

    Today: Windows 10/11 64-bit and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. Intel Macs are not supported.

    Rebind works with standard-HID USB keyboards and mice.

    Software mode can use a built-in laptop keyboard and trackpad. Hardware mode is different: only peripherals you attach in Peripherals reach scripts.

    Install Rebind

    Two steps: install the app, then run a script. The button opens https://www.rebind.gg/install.

    Choose your computer: Windows or macOS.

    Download for Windows Free to download.

    Version on rebind.gg/download, 23 Nov 2026: v3.22.6. Get the current version at www.rebind.gg/install. No account needed to install. No account for local scripts. Software mode needs no extra hardware.

      After you open the install page

      The button opens the Rebind install page in a new tab. You install from there, not from this page.

      On the install page, follow the steps for your computer. When the Rebind app opens, step one is done.

      Then run a script. The Welcome Tour starts on a fresh install. Or open Scripts, click New File, paste the Caps Lock to Escape example from the Quickstart, then click Save and Run.

      Help: docs.rebind.gg/getting-started/quickstart

      If you are on a phone

      Rebind installs on a computer, not a phone. Android and iOS apps are in development.

      Copy the install link and open it on your computer. Today: Windows 10/11 64-bit and macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon.
